test_results.interpretation: Verbatim formulaic recurrence on D1 is highly non-random under within-column shuffling (detection pooled corpus-wide): longest D1 repeat 6-token VII litany frame (male·ceia·hia·etnam·ciz·vacl, VII:3=VII:5); F-B core cisum·pute·tul x5. Strengthens the structural claim (I-1/I-8) ONLY. No functional/semantic promotion (report 04 section 5). Note: the calibrated-layer 7 (F-B V:5=V:12) has no D1 counterpart -- V:12 absent from D1 (SOURCE GAP in D1).

etnam positional entropy (0.919; 3 initial / 28 medial / 4 final) is NOT significantly higher than the next-10 frequent tokens' (tul 1.241, vacl 1.087, vinum 1.041 exceed it). I-4's positional-freedom claim is not distinguished from 'frequent word' by this measure. Descriptive residue: etnam does occupy all three edge classes and has 44 distinct neighbor types.

test_results.effect: null saturates: 10000/10000 replicates produce a pseudo-class with ratio >= 0.5789 under both functionals (a) and (b)
test_results.interpretation: The declared statistic (type/token ratio) cannot discriminate morpheme productivity from chance aggregation under the declared random-segmentation null: uniform random splits invariably yield 1-char pseudo-suffix classes aggregating dozens of tokens across many distinct types (ratio 1.0 attainable). No substitute test run. Descriptive: -ri ranks #2/#3 of 178 two-letter endings (22 types/38 tokens); -ti (23/25) and -ic (20/26) are comparably productive, consistent with phonotactic generation of high productivity. A discriminating test needs a new preregistration.
